args.title: Add group_aggregate with numeric coercion and composite-key helpers
args.body:
## Summary

Adds a new `group_aggregate(records, key, aggregations)` core feature plus two supporting helpers, following the existing pure-function style of the library.

### New public API
- **`group_aggregate(records, key, aggregations)`** (`src/dataproc/core.py`) — groups records by `key` (single field or a sequence of fields for a composite key) and applies a dict of named aggregations. Each entry maps an output name to a `(op, field)` pair where `op` is one of `sum`, `mean`, `count`, `min`, `max`. Returns one record per group, preserving first-appearance order. Raises `KeyError` for missing key/value fields and `ValueError` for malformed specs / unknown ops.
- **`coerce_numeric(value)`** (`src/dataproc/helpers.py`) — safely converts values to numbers, returning `None` for non-numeric input (and treating `bool` as non-numeric). Numeric aggregations use it so numeric strings participate and non-numeric values are ignored.
- **`merge_group_keys(records, keys)`** (`src/dataproc/helpers.py`) — builds a composite grouping key tuple per record; missing fields contribute `None`. Powers the multi-field grouping path in `group_aggregate`.

### Other changes
- `src/dataproc/__init__.py` now exports `group_aggregate`, `coerce_numeric`, and `merge_group_keys`.
- README public-API section updated.

### Tests
- New `tests/test_group_aggregate.py` and `tests/test_helpers.py` cover normal paths and edge cases: empty input, malformed/typed specs, missing fields, boundary values, purity (no input mutation), composite keys, and numeric coercion behavior.
- Full suite: 59 passed locally.

### Notes on scope / coordination
- No changes to any forbidden infrastructure files (`project_rules.yaml`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.ci/`).
- I'm aware `sam-lee` has an in-progress refactor (`refactor/core-cleanup`) touching `src/dataproc/core.py`. I did not touch or revert their branch; this PR only appends new functions and leaves existing functions unchanged to minimize conflict. Happy to rebase/coordinate on merge order.
